protocol.order: A/B/A/B (side A first: the dynG baseline)
protocol.lock: perf.lock: held exclusively by this process

gpu_clocks.how: ncu --clock-control boost on parity/clock_lock/clock_holder.cu (idle, one kernel) for the whole A/B; the timed programs are not profiled
gpu_clocks.check: every busy GPU sample of every accepted round at the locked clocks

protocol.contamination_monitor: per round and side: foreign CPU load (machine busy time minus the harness and its programs), run queue, GPU P-state / clocks / utilization every 50 ms and foreign compute processes on the GPU every second; limit 2.0 cores; contaminated rounds repeated

monitor.rule: a round is repeated if, during either side, the CPUs were busy outside the harness for more than 2.0 cores on average or a foreign compute process was on the timed GPU
